bear_assumptions: USD 0.55 normalized forward EPS at 12x after removing the tariff refund; elevated memory pricing, discretionary weakness, integration costs, customer concentration or margin reversion suppress recurring earnings and cash conversion.
base_assumptions: USD 0.80 normalized forward EPS at 15x after removing the tariff refund; peripherals and creator growth, adequate component supply, improved underlying margin and modest deferred-demand recovery convert raised guidance while acquisition spending and dilution remain controlled.
bull_assumptions: USD 1.05 normalized forward EPS at 18x as Fanatec, Trak Racer, Elgato and Stream Deck scale, deferred DIY demand returns, AI workstations add profitable revenue, underlying margins persist and cash-funded acquisitions earn attractive returns.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade to an actionable frontier only if fresh results preserve normalized earnings and cash conversion while bear/base and expected/bear payoff and the accepted-relationship gate clear; downgrade if underlying margins revert after the tariff refund, peripherals growth fails to offset component weakness, working-capital cash reverses, Trak Racer or the licensed technology destroys value, customer concentration worsens, or dilution overwhelms per-share growth.
